questions.question: Agar PS I ke aage NADP⁺ tak jaane ka raasta hi band ho, toh roshni se uchhla electron kahan jaayega, aur kya tab bhi kuch banega?
questions.hook: Route puzzle: P700 se nikla electron NADP⁺ ko jaane ke bajay P700 par hi laut aaye toh?

points.point: Living organisms have the capability of extracting energy from oxidisable substances and store this in the form of bond energy. Special substances like ATP, carry this energy in their chemical bonds.
ATP is synthesised by cells (in mitochondria and chloroplasts) is named phosphorylation. Photo-phosphorylation is the synthesis of ATP from ADP and inorganic phosphate in the presence of light.

teacher_lines.roman: Pichhli film mein humne dekha ki PS II ka khoya hua electron paani se aata hai.
teacher_lines.note: recap · screen: Z scheme ka raasta ek chalti line ki tarah: paani, PS II, carriers ki kadi, PS I, NADP⁺; paani ke do molecule toot kar 4 e⁻, 4 H⁺ aur ek O₂; aakhri line par PS I ke aage NADP⁺ wala raasta band.

teacher_lines.roman: Do paani ke molecule tootte hain, aur chaar electron, chaar H⁺ aur ek O₂ milte hain.
Usse pehle Z scheme mein electron ka poora safar dekha tha: paani se PS II, phir carriers ki kadi, phir PS I, aur aakhir mein NADP⁺.
Ab socho: agar PS I ke aage NADP⁺ tak jaane ka raasta hi band ho, toh roshni se uchhla electron kahan jaayega?
Aur kya tab bhi kuch banega?
Is sawaal ka jawab isi film mein milega.
teacher_lines.note: explain · screen: Energy ki zaroorat ke chhote drishya (saans, chalna, naya molecule); glucose se energy; oxidation = electron dena, reduction = electron lena; gulel ki khinchi rubber (apni tasveer); atomon ke beech chemical bond mein band energy; ATP: adenosine ke saath teen phosphate, ADP: do phosphate; bhari aur khaali battery (apni tasveer); ADP + Pᵢ → ATP, jodne mein energy; mitochondria aur chloroplast; dhoop se phone bharta solar charger (apni tasveer); roshni ke saath ADP + Pᵢ → ATP.

teacher_lines.roman: Par usse pehle ek zaroori cheez pakki kar lo: ATP.
Har jeev ko kaam ke liye energy chahiye: saans lene ke liye, chalne ke liye, ek naya molecule banane ke liye.
Yeh energy jeev kuch cheezon se nikaalte hain, jaise khaane ka glucose.
Yaad karo, oxidation ka matlab hai electron dena, aur reduction ka matlab hai electron lena.
Jo cheezein oxidation mein electron de sakti hain, unhe oxidisable substances kehte hain.
Glucose aisi hi ek cheez hai.
Glucose se energy kaise nikalti hai, yeh aap aage respiration wale chapter mein padhoge.
Abhi bas itna jaan lo ki aisi cheezon se energy nikalti hai.
Nikli hui energy jeev turant kharch nahi karte.
Use molecules ke andar band karke rakh lete hain.
Band karke isliye rakhte hain kyunki energy ki zaroorat har jagah aur har pal hoti hai, aur band energy ko jahan chaaho wahan le ja sakte ho.
Socho ek gulel, jiski rubber ko kheench kar pakad liya.
Energy us khinchi hui rubber mein band hai; chhodoge toh kaam karegi.
Molecule mein atom aapas mein bandhanon se jude hote hain, jinhe chemical bonds kehte hain.
In bonds mein bhi aise hi energy band rehti hai; ise bond energy kehte hain.
ATP ek aisa hi khaas molecule hai.
Yeh apne chemical bonds mein energy lekar chalta hai, aur cell ke har kaam tak pahunchata hai.
ATP ka poora naam hai adenosine triphosphate.
Tri yaani teen, toh isme teen phosphate jude hain.
ADP yaani adenosine diphosphate.
Di yaani do, toh isme do hi phosphate hain.
ATP ko ek bhari hui battery samjho, aur ADP ko ek khaali hoti battery.
Khaali battery ko phir se bharna hai, toh ADP mein ek phosphate aur jodna padta hai.
Aur is jodne mein energy lagti hai.
Jo phosphate akela hai, kisi molecule se juda nahi, use inorganic phosphate kehte hain.
Chhote mein ise Pᵢ likhte hain; i yaani inorganic.
ADP mein phosphate jodkar ATP banane ko phosphorylation kehte hain.
Phosphate jodna, isliye naam phosphorylation.
Cell yeh kaam do jagah karta hai: mitochondria mein aur chloroplast mein.
Mitochondria wala tareeka bhi aap respiration wale chapter mein padhoge.
Hamari kahani chloroplast ki hai.
Chloroplast mein yeh charging roshni se hoti hai, bilkul waise jaise solar charger dhoop se phone charge karta hai.
Roshni ki madad se ADP aur inorganic phosphate se ATP banane ko photo-phosphorylation kehte hain, kyunki photo ka matlab hi roshni hai.

questions.question: Cyclic aur non-cyclic photophosphorylation mein kya difference hai?
questions.hook: Route puzzle: P700 se nikla electron NADP⁺ ko jaane ke bajay P700 par hi laut aaye toh?

teacher_lines.roman: Ab Figure 11.5 wali Z scheme yaad karo, jo hum pehle padh chuke hain.
teacher_lines.note: explain · screen: Z scheme: PS II aur PS I, dono par roshni, beech mein carriers ki kadi; relay daud (apni tasveer): baton electron, khiladi carriers; electron paani se NADP⁺ tak pahunch kar NADPH; ATP, NADPH aur O₂; seedha raasta jo shuru par wapas nahi aata.

teacher_lines.roman: Usme do photosystem the: pehle PS II, phir PS I. Dono par roshni padti thi.
Dono ke beech carriers ki ek kadi thi, jo electron ko ek se doosre tak aage deti hai.
Is kadi ko electron transport chain kehte hain: electron ka transport, yaani le jaana, ek chain mein.
Ise ek relay daud ki tarah socho.
Har khiladi baton ko agle khiladi ke haath mein deta hai, aur baton aage badhta jaata hai.
Yahan baton hai electron, aur khiladi hain carriers.
Roshni do jagah zor ka dhakka deti hai: PS II par aur PS I par.
Is daud mein baton paani se chalta hai.
PS II aur PS I se hokar, aakhir mein NADP⁺ ke haath mein pahunchta hai.
NADP⁺ electron le leta hai aur NADPH ban jaata hai.
Baton wahin ruk gaya; woh wapas shuru par nahi aata.
Toh is raaste mein do cheezein banti hain: ATP aur NADPH.
Saath mein paani tootne se O₂ bhi nikalti hai.
Aksar ise NADPH + H⁺ likhte hain.
Iska matlab bas itna hai ki NADPH ke saath ek H⁺ bhi likha jaata hai.
Dhyan do, electron ek seedhe raaste par aage gaya, aur jahan se chala tha wahan wapas nahi lauta.
Raasta gol nahi hai.
Isliye ise non-cyclic photo-phosphorylation kehte hain.
Cyclic yaani gol chakkar wala, aur non-cyclic yaani jo gol chakkar na ho.
Yaad rakho: non-cyclic mein dono photosystem ek ke baad ek kaam karte hain, pehle PS II, phir PS I. Aur ATP ke saath NADPH bhi banta hai.
Ab Figure 11.6 dekho.
teacher_lines.note: figure · screen: Cyclic photophosphorylation ka figure jaisa drishya, har label tabhi jab line uska naam le: Photosystem I bracket, Chlorophyll P 700, Light ki peeli dashed teer, upar e⁻ acceptor tak gulabi teer, Electron transport system, wapas P 700 tak teer, ADP + Pi → ATP; relay mein khiladi track ka chakkar lagakar lautta (apni tasveer); aakhir mein dikhe ki PS II aur NADP⁺ ka raasta nahi hai.

teacher_lines.roman: Yahan ek bilkul alag raasta hai.
Sabse upar bracket mein likha hai Photosystem I. Matlab is figure mein sirf PS I ka kaam dikhaya gaya hai; ise kahin-kahin PSI bhi likha milta hai.
Neeche likha hai Chlorophyll P 700.
Yeh PS I ka reaction centre hai, jo lagbhag 700 nm ki roshni pakadta hai.
Peeli dashed teer par Light likha hai.
Roshni seedhe P 700 par padti hai.
Roshni padte hi P 700 ka electron energy lekar uchhalta hai.
Ungli rakho: gulabi teer seedhe upar e⁻ acceptor tak jaata hai.
e⁻ electron ka nishaan hai.
Aur e⁻ acceptor woh molecule hai jo uchhla hua electron sabse pehle pakadta hai.
Ab acceptor se ek mudi hui gulabi teer neeche Electron transport system tak aati hai.
Yeh carriers ki wahi kadi hai.
Ab ungli aage le chalo.
Is kadi ke baad gulabi teer kahan jaati hai?
Is kadi ke baad gulabi teer wapas P 700 par hi pahunchti hai, wahin jahan se electron chala tha.
Electron ne ek gol chakkar poora kiya: P 700 se acceptor, phir kadi, phir wapas P 700.
Isi gol chakkar ki wajah se ise cyclic kehte hain.
Relay wali daud yaad hai?
Yahan baton kisi ko diya hi nahi gaya.
Khiladi track ka ek chakkar lagakar wahin laut aaya jahan se chala tha.
Ab kadi ke paas ek kaali mudi teer dekho: ADP + Pi se ATP.
Yaani is chakkar ke saath ATP banta hai.
Isliye ise cyclic photophosphorylation kehte hain: roshni se, ek gol chakkar ke saath, ATP banana.
Aur yeh bhi dekho ki figure mein kya nahi hai: na PS II hai, na NADP⁺ tak jaane wala raasta.

teacher_lines.roman: Toh shuruaat ka sawaal: jab NADP⁺ tak jaane ka raasta na ho, toh electron kahan jaata hai?
teacher_lines.note: explain · screen: Electron wapas PS I par; chloroplast ka naksha: grana sikkon ke dher jaise, unhe jodti stroma lamellae galiyare jaisi; grana ki membrane mein PS I aur PS II, stroma lamellae mein sirf PS I (PS II aur NADP reductase nahi); lautta electron; sirf ATP; 680 nm aur 700 nm ki lehrein, 680 se lambi lehar.

teacher_lines.roman: Jab NADP⁺ tak raasta na ho, toh electron carriers ki kadi se hokar wapas PS I par laut aata hai.
Aisa tab hota hai jab sirf PS I kaam kar raha ho.
Electron PS I ke andar hi chakkar lagata rehta hai.
Is gol bahav ke saath jo phosphorylation hoti hai, wahi cyclic photo-phosphorylation hai.
Par chloroplast mein aisa kahan ho sakta hai, yeh samajhne ke liye pehle uske andar ka naksha yaad karo.
Chloroplast mein thylakoid ki chapti thailiyan sikkon ki tarah ek ke upar ek rakhi hoti hain.
Inke dher grana kehlate hain.
Do dheron ko jodne wali patli, bina dher wali membrane bhi hoti hai, jaise do imaraton ke beech ka galiyara.
Inhe hum pehle stroma lamellae ke naam se dekh chuke hain; lamella yaani patli parat.
Grana ki membrane mein dono photosystem hote hain, PS I bhi aur PS II bhi.
Par stroma lamellae ki membrane mein PS II nahi hota.
Aur NADP reductase enzyme bhi nahi hota.
NADP reductase woh enzyme hai jo NADP⁺ se NADPH banne ka kaam karata hai.
Reductase yaani reduction karaane wala.
Toh socho, stroma lamellae mein uchhle electron ko NADP⁺ tak pahunchane wala enzyme hi nahi hai.
Isliye electron ke paas wapas lautne ke siva koi raasta nahi.
Isliye stroma lamellae ko cyclic photo-phosphorylation ki ek sambhav jagah maana jaata hai.
Nateeja pakka yaad rakho: gol raaste mein sirf ATP banta hai, NADPH + H⁺ nahi banta.
Aksar log sochte hain ki light reaction mein hamesha ATP, NADPH aur O₂ teeno banenge.
Par aisa nahi hai: gol raaste mein electron NADP⁺ tak jaata hi nahi, aur PS II ke bina paani bhi nahi tootta, isliye sirf ATP banta hai.
Ek aur haalat hai.
Yaad karo, roshni lehron mein chalti hai, aur ek lehar ki chot se agli chot tak ki doori wavelength hai.
PS II ka centre P680 hai, jo lagbhag 680 nm ki roshni chahta hai.
PS I ka P700, 700 nm tak ki roshni bhi pakad leta hai.
Jab sirf 680 nm se aage ki roshni mile, toh PS II theek se nahi jaagta.
Sirf PS I chalta hai, aur cyclic photo-phosphorylation hoti hai.
Aksar log ise ulta samajh lete hain, par 680 nm se aage ka matlab hai 680 se zyada, yaani lambi wavelength, kam wavelength nahi.
Paudhe ko yeh gol raasta kyon chahiye, iska ek bada kaaran hum aage Calvin cycle mein dekhenge.
Abhi bas itna jaan lo ki kabhi paudhe ko NADPH se zyada ATP chahiye hota hai.
Ab ek electron ko pakad kar stroma lamellae mein uska poora safar chalate hain.
teacher_lines.note: example · screen: Stroma lamellae mein ek electron ka safar, kadam-kadam ek hi tasveer par: P 700 par roshni, electron uchhla, e⁻ acceptor, kadi, NADP reductase ki khaali jagah, wapas P 700; ATP bana, NADPH aur O₂ nahi.

teacher_lines.roman: Roshni P 700 par padi, aur uska ek electron energy lekar uchhal gaya.
e⁻ acceptor ne use pakda, aur woh carriers ki kadi mein aage badha.
Kadi ke aage use NADP⁺ tak le jaane wala NADP reductase mila hi nahi, kyunki yahan woh enzyme hai hi nahi.
Toh electron kadi se ghoom kar wapas P 700 par aa gaya, aur agli roshni ka intezaar karne laga.
Is ek chakkar ke saath ATP bana.
NADPH ek bhi nahi bana, aur O₂ bhi nahi nikli.
Ruko, pehle khud socho: agar kisi patti par sirf 700 nm wali roshni pade, toh usme NADPH banega ya nahi?
teacher_lines.note: checkpoint · screen: Sawaal screen par; dono raaste saath-saath: non-cyclic (paani, PS II, PS I, NADP⁺; ATP, NADPH, O₂) aur cyclic (PS I se wapas P 700; sirf ATP); aakhir mein electron aur ADP ke beech khaali jagah.

teacher_lines.roman: Aapne socha hoga ki NADPH nahi banega, aur yahi sahi hai.
Aisi roshni mein sirf PS I chalega, electron gol chakkar lagayega, aur sirf ATP banega.
Ab dono raaste ek saath rakh kar dekho.
Seedhe raaste, yaani non-cyclic, mein electron paani se chalta hai: pehle PS II, phir PS I, aur aakhir NADP⁺.
ATP, NADPH aur O₂ teeno bante hain.
Gol raaste, yaani cyclic, mein sirf PS I kaam karta hai, aur electron wapas P 700 par aata hai.
Sirf ATP banta hai; na NADPH, na O₂.
Ab ek ajeeb baat par gaur karo, jo hamari agli film ka sawaal hai: dono raaston mein ATP bana, par electron ne kahin bhi ADP ko chhua tak nahi.
Toh ATP bana kaise?
